description: Wastewater treatment locations is a dataset listed in Geonorge, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Miljødataseksjonen. Datasettet omfatter oversikt over utslipp av kommunalt avløpsvann. Dataene er framskaffet ved den årlige rapporteringen fra kommunene til KOSTRA. Coverage: Miljødataseksjonen. The publisher named on the listing is Miljødataseksjonen. Its keywords include kommunalt avløp, avløpsanlegg, renseprinsipp, Norge. The listing shows 2021-01-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geonorge.
